prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: Create a cinematic, moody close-up of an open vintage book resting on a dark surface, illuminated by soft, focused lighting that creates dramatic shadows and highlights the aged, yellowed pages. The book is open to two pages featuring intricate, technical black-and-white line drawings: on the left, a complex mechanical diagram with gears and labeled parts, and below it, a classical illustration of two human profiles facing each other, suggesting communication or observation. On the right page, a large circular diagram filled with jagged lines and waveforms dominates the composition, surrounded by smaller notations and text. The upper portion of the pages contains sparse, typewritten text in English, adding an academic or mysterious tone. Out-of-focus palm leaves partially obscure the top of the book, casting organic shadows across the pages and contributing to a sense of secrecy or discovery. The background is dark and softly blurred, with a subtle teal-blue glow that hints at an otherworldly or nocturnal setting. The overall style is reminiscent of a film noir or a suspenseful science fiction film, with a shallow depth of field, careful attention to texture, and a sense of quiet intrigue.
